frank: FYI - Partner Ops pinged: several Azure marketplace invoices returned by the payment gateway due to missing meter_id on line items. Seeing 'invalid_meter_id' in gateway logs. Anyone else?

sara: I'm seeing the same in ingestion logs. The marketplace feed for a subset of partners includes a trailing space in the meter_id field which causes the join to our `metering_catalog`. So invoices are generated with meter_id = '' (empty) after normalization.

tony: Can you paste an example? I'll pull ledger rows.

sara: Sample (sanitized):
```
invoice: 55432 | partner: cloudharbor | sku: AZ-EMBED-XL | raw_meter_id: "meter_az_019 " | normalized_meter_id: "" | amount_usd: 1200.00
```
We trim and validate but the trailing space makes the lookup fail.

frank: That explains payment rejects. Partner-success, heads-up for comms. Do we pause settlement for impacted partners?

partner-success: Yes please pause settlement until we reconcile. We'll prep a short note offering corrected invoice and expedited re-settlement. Prioritize any partner with > $1k exposure. :handshake:

ton y: (typo) Tony: I'll open a hotfix to trim whitespace at ingestion and add a fallback lookup by SKU->meter mapping. Also will queue a recompute for invoices created between 2026-04-05 00:00 - 06:00 UTC. Need finance sign-off for recompute and possible gateway retry.

billing-bot: Job queued: invoice-recompute-2017773333 by tony; est 20m. job-id: rc_2017773333_1

sara: Uploaded CSV with impacted invoices: https://drive.redwood/finance/azure-meterid-mismatch-2017773333.csv (cols: invoice_id, partner_id, raw_meter_id, contact_email, exposure_usd).

frank: Finance - please authorize recompute and reattempt settlement for invoices once corrected. I'll hold collections for impacted partners.

partner-success: Draft comms started. We'll include apology, corrected statement, and offer a call. We'll cc account executives for top 5 partners.

sara: After hotfix deploy, I'll run a lookup patch to backfill normalized_meter_id and then trigger recompute. Posting updates here only. Thanks.
